title: Bias in Conversational Search: The Double-Edged Sword of the Personalized Knowledge Graph

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed method of measuring bias in conversational search by comparing results generated with a user's personalized knowledge graph against those generated with an "opposite knowledge graph" where gender terms (e.g., Female/Male) are swapped.

Proposed method of measuring bias in conversational search by comparing results generated with a user's personalized knowledge graph against those generated with an "opposite knowledge graph" where political alignment terms (e.g., right-wing/left-wing, conservative/progressive) are swapped.
